a: Quantum physics describes nature at atomic and subatomic scales.
A photon is a quantum of electromagnetic radiation.
Heisenberg uncertainty limits simultaneous knowledge of certain pairs of properties.
Matter and light can show both wave and particle behavior.
Electrons in atoms occupy discrete energy levels.
Fission splits heavy nuclei and can release energy.
Fusion combines light nuclei and powers stars.
Special relativity links space and time for inertial frames.
Moving clocks run slow relative to a stationary observer.
E = mc² relates mass and energy.
